stemMd: Two concentric circles have radii 5 cm and 3 cm. What is the area of the region between them?
explanationMd: The annular area is outer area minus inner area: π(5² − 3²) = π(25 − 9) = 16π cm². Squaring the radius difference would describe a different circle.

distractorRationale.d: This squares the difference of radii rather than subtracting squared radii.
distractorRationale.c: This does not use the circle-area formula correctly.
distractorRationale.e: This adds the two circle areas instead of subtracting.
distractorRationale.b: This is the whole outer-circle area.
